FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 266
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator Tom Butler
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 03/31/2025
Senate Bill 266 as introduced would require all personal and non-legal professional services
contracts paid from appropriated funds to be subject to review by the Contract Review
Permanent Legislative Oversight Committee. This bill would not directly affect state or local
funding.
